title: Valuative criteria for adic spaces
summary: We establish valuative criteria for separatedness and (partial) properness for morphisms of adic spaces, which account for both vertical and horizontal specializations. The lifting test diagrams used in Huber's analytic valuative criteria are naturally adapted to vertical specializations. In the non-analytic setting, one must additionally include lifting conditions for horizontal specializations.
